# Third-party notices for the PptxGlimpse browser bundle

This file contains the license notices for all third-party packages identified in the bundled source regions and their precompiled dependency chunks. Resolved versions and license expressions were read from each package's `package.json`. License texts below are copied from each package's published license file. The package names and versions are also summarized in the presentation module README.

The `@xmldom/xmldom@0.9.12` and `rtf.js@3.0.9` sources are embedded in precompiled `pptx-glimpse` chunks rather than installed as separate package directories in the Vite build's top-level `node_modules`. Their exact-version npm tarballs were unpacked and their `package.json` and `LICENSE` files were inspected. EMFJS and WMFJS are modules shipped by `rtf.js`, not separate packages.

`xml-naming@0.3.0` was resolved in the Vite build's `node_modules`; its inlined validator implementation is imported by `fast-xml-builder`. Its version, MIT license identifier, and complete notice below were read from that package's `package.json` and `LICENSE`.

`tiny-inflate@1.0.3` and `string.prototype.codepointat@0.2.1` are runtime dependencies of resolved `opentype.js@1.3.4`. Their implementations are included in PptxGlimpse's precompiled font code: the WOFF decompressor calls the tiny inflater, and the `String.prototype.codePointAt` polyfill is embedded. Their metadata and license files were read from the resolved Vite build's `node_modules`.
